rows.heading: ## Pin disposition and provenance correction — round 13
rows.claim: `python3 tools/pin-disposition.py --manifest .ufo/evidence/round-13/pin-manifest.json --root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin` observes only hashes and git metadata. Retain stdout with its sibling branch-tip commits before treating it as a dated reading.
rows.excerpt: Read-only guarantees: the tool never writes to a target repo or worktree. Git is used only through read-only plumbing (`rev-parse`, `symbolic-ref`, `show-ref`, `for-each-ref`, `cat-file`), never `status`, `diff` or `hash-object`; the index, filters and hooks are never invoked.
rows.note: CLI is `--manifest PATH --root FLEET` (parse_argv, tools/pin-disposition.py:1336-1366), matching the recipe line verbatim. Read-only guarantee block sits at :82-90; every subprocess call is git plumbing (:227-235, selftest :770-790), so 'executes no sibling gate' holds. Selftest exit 1 on failure is at :1320-1330, matching the adjacent '### Round-13 gate/probe registry' row's verdict-map cell (SKILL.md:1550, outside this section's counted text). Observed: `TMPDIR=$S python3 -B tools/pin-disposition.py --selftest` -> SELFTEST: PASS (19/19), exit 0. Bound: the selftest hardcodes dir='/tmp' (:706), so TMPDIR does not redirect it; the fixture tree is removed on pass (:1328).
